Nora (Partnerships): Heads-up: HW partner wants a single-file marketplace tile + an "airgapped" OTLP example for appliances. SI wants a reproducible installer snippet. Can we draft minimal deliverables?
Diego (Solutions Eng): I can draft a unix-socket OTLP collector example and recommendations for span attributes. Keep the tile to 3 panels: latency p95, fallback rate, and errors by route.
Priya (Docs): I'll write the short how-to and marketplace blurb. Need the collector snippet and a short troubleshooting list (DNS/SSL/TLS, missing env vars).
Hiro (SI): From SI: we need an installer hook that creates the socket, a systemd unit, and a small smoke-test that verifies `inference.generate` spans arrive. We'll test in our airgapped lab.
Clara (Legal): Reminder: public copy must be opt-in for telemetry forwarding. Mask any sample IDs in screenshots. No claims about retention or export guarantees.
Diego (Solutions Eng): Quick collector example (unix socket receiver -> file exporter for relay):
```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc:
      http:
    unix_socket: "/var/run/otel/otlp.sock"
exporters:
  file:
    path: /var/log/otel/out.json
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      exporters: [file]
```
Diego (Solutions Eng): Span naming guidance: use `inference.generate` with attrs: `model.name`, `tokens.in`, `tokens.out`, `fallback.reason`. Keep attribute values non-sensitive (no raw prompts).
Priya (Docs): Marketplace blurb draft: "Redwood + Partner observability tile: compact dashboards, OTLP collector examples for on-prem appliances, and an SI playbook for air-gapped installs. Opt-in telemetry forwarding only."
Hiro (SI): Installer plan: create `/var/run/otel` dir, systemd unit for otelcol daemon, post-install smoke test script: `curl --unix-socket /var/run/otel/otlp.sock -X POST /v1/traces -d @sample_trace.json` to validate. We'll add TLS cert troubleshooting steps.
Clara (Legal): Approved with edits: add explicit opt-in sentence and remove references to customer text. Also request 48h embargo window for joint announcement.
Nora (Partnerships): Thanks. Plan: Diego -> collector + span doc by tomorrow AM, Priya -> blurb + how-to and screenshots (masked) by tomorrow noon, Hiro -> installer + smoke test in lab (3 days). I'll coordinate embargo calendar with Legal. :calendar: 
deploy-bot: Notice: marketplace-preview build #678 succeeded for branch `marketplace/hw-si-airgap-otlp` - preview: https://redwood.internal/preview/678
Priya (Docs): Preview looks good, dashboards render compactly. Pushed PR with masked screenshots.
Hiro (SI): Lab tests passed for installer; smoke test returns spans with expected attributes. Posting logs to the PR.
Nora (Partnerships): Great — once Legal confirms embargo window I'll file the submission to Datadog marketplace and loop in the partner PMs. :tada:
